specs.Item Highlight: For Kindle Scribe 10.2in 2022, Black PU Leather, Folding Stand, Protective Folio, Reading and Writing Support

features: SLEEK CASE COVER FOR KINDLE SCRIBE: A sleek and modern textured surface design in black enhances the premium feel of your Kindle Scribe, turning it into not just a reading device but a fashion statement. Enjoy a sophisticated look that seamlessly blends with both professional and casual settings, elevating your style effortlessly.

SNUG FIT: Tailored specifically for the Kindle Scribe 10.2'' (2022 release), this PU leather case ensures a snug fit that hugs your device securely. Experience unparalleled protection against accidental drops and scratches, while maintaining easy access to all buttons and features without any bulk.

SUPERIOR PROTECTION: Crafted from high-quality materials, the leather case provides robust protection against daily wear and tear. Safeguard your Kindle Scribe from potential damage, enhancing its longevity and ensuring that your investment remains pristine for years to come.

INNOVATIVE MULTI ANGLE FOLDING STAND: One the piece of the Kindle Scribe cover features a unique folding design that allows it to fold into multiple angles, providing a versatile and customizable viewing experience for you. This innovative design ensures that you can position your Kindle Scribe at the perfect angle for reading, writing, or browsing, whether you're sitting at a desk or lounging on the couch.

STYLE MEETS FUNCTIONALITIES: More than just a protective cover, this case doubles as a fashion piece. Whether you're at work, traveling, or relaxing at home, showcase your Kindle Scribe with a touch of elegance. Elevate your reading experience by merging functionality with high fashion.
description: This Kindle Scribe cover is designed for the 10.2-inch Amazon Kindle Scribe (2022 release), helping protect the device during everyday reading at home, work, or while travelling. The stand format supports comfortable hands-free viewing for your e-reader. The PU leather cover combines device coverage with viewing support in one practical design. It is suited to readers who want an organised way to carry and use their Kindle Scribe without relying on a separate stand. Compared with using the Amazon Kindle device without a cover, this case helps shield the exterior during handling and provides a dedicated stand position for reading. Its cover-and-stand design keeps two useful functions together for daily use. Place the Kindle Scribe correctly inside the cover before use and keep the edges aligned. Clean the PU leather surface with a soft, dry cloth. Store the covered device away from sharp objects and avoid prolonged exposure to moisture.
